verdict.rationale: Ramp's reimbursements page says its Google Maps integration provides automatic mileage calculations, which covers map-based mileage logging, and employees can submit repayment requests on web or mobile. The per-diem evidence is weaker: it says per diem shows what you can purchase and adjusts by trip location and duration. That describes a travel spending allowance, not a documented flow for claiming per-diem reimbursement without building the expense by hand. Missing for 10: an explicit per-diem claim/reimbursement workflow, in-depth docs on the mileage logging flow (route entry, rates), and independent or hands-on corroboration of either feature.
